attackers_goals: Attackers can attempt to use the command to discover remote systems they could compromise.
description: The route.exe command is used to display and modify entries in the local IP routing table. Adversaries may attempt to use the command to discover remote systems they could compromise.
investigative_actions: Check whether the command line executed is benign or normal for the host and/or user performing it (e.g. an IT script).
name: Uncommon routing table listing via route.exe
